heading: Winter Wine in the Okanagan
title: Okanagan Winter Wine & Icewine | Okanagan Roam
description: Okanagan icewine specialists in West Kelowna and Kaleden, plus guided wine tour companies that run winter wine tours from Big White and SilverStar.
intro: Wine country is quieter in winter, and that can be a good time to slow down and taste. Icewine, the sweet dessert wine the Okanagan is known for, suits a cold day especially well, and a few wineries make it their focus.

Below are the wineries whose listings single out icewine, plus two tour companies that run winter wine tours from the ski hills. Winery hours change through the off-season, so check before you drive out. Each place shows its town.

items.name: Grizzli Winery
items.text: specializes in icewine, poured from a striking welcome centre that's also earned an official live-music venue designation. A stop worth making to taste icewine done by specialists rather than as an afterthought pour. Rated 4.5 stars.

items.name: Kalala Organic Estate Winery
items.text: an organic winery on the upper bench of West Kelowna, best known for rich, well-balanced ice wines and called a hidden gem for dessert wine lovers. Rated 4.9 stars.

items.name: Kraze Legz Vineyard and Winery
items.text: a small, cozy winery where the port and ice wine are the styles reviewers single out, with a clever deer-proof automatic gate protecting the vines. Rated 4.5 stars.

sections.heading: Winter wine tours from the ski hills

items.name: Cheers! Okanagan Tours and Transportation
items.text: all-inclusive guided wine tours to farm-gate and estate wineries around Kelowna and Vernon, including wheelchair-accessible tours. Also runs winter wine tours from Big White and SilverStar.

items.name: Toast the Okanagan Wine Tours
items.text: a small wine tour company with over 10 years running guided tasting tours of West Kelowna, East Kelowna, Lake Country, Summerland and Naramata, with hotel pickup. Also offers winter wine tours departing from Big White.
